items.headline: FCC officially decides gigabit speeds are too good for you
items.facts: FCC Chairman Brendan Carr decided to cancel long‑term broadband speed goals, ending the push for gigabit downloads.

items.headline: How Florida quietly removed climate change content from textbooks
items.facts: Florida state requested publishers to dilute climate change content; publishers complied, altering textbook language.

framing.narrativeTitle: Florida State and Publishers Swap Words on Climate
framing.publicBrief: Florida state asked publishers to soften climate change talk in school books. Publishers changed the words to meet the request. The state keeps the new text, the publishers keep the rest of the book.

roleFlavor.proposer: You are Florida state. You want the books to say less about climate change.
roleFlavor.responder: You are Publishers. You want to keep the original words but must obey the state.

howItWorks: Florida state tells publishers what to say in the books.
Publishers can choose to follow the request or refuse.
If they follow, the books change and Florida keeps the new text.
If they refuse, the books stay the same but Florida may act against them.
missionCopy.choicePrompt: Will the publishers change the words?

outcomes.COOPERATIVE: Publishers changed the words. Florida keeps the new text.
outcomes.BETRAYAL: Publishers kept the original words. Florida may act against them.
outcomes.MIXED: Publishers partially changed the words. Florida keeps the new text.

items.headline: The Dinner Party Has Left the Building
items.facts: Artists created a dinner setting on a natural rock by a waterfall and invited diners to eat there.

framing.publicBrief: Charles Michel set a table on a rock by a waterfall. He invited diners to eat there. The water rushes around the stone. The air is cool and wet. It is night. The table is ready. The food is hot. The diners must decide if they will come. They can stay home for safety. Or they can join him for the meal. The lights are low. The sound of water is loud.

roleFlavor.hunter: You are part of the group invited to eat. You hold your place at the table. You risk the wet rocks. You see the fire and the food if you come.

STAG.label: JOIN THE MEAL
STAG.meaning: Walk to the rock and sit down.
STAG.outcome: You eat the feast together. The night is a success.

HARE.label: STAY HOME
HARE.outcome: You stay dry and safe. The table remains empty.

howItWorks: Both guests choose at the same time. Neither can see the other. If both join, the party happens. If both stay, nothing happens.
If one joins and the other stays, the guest who joins is left alone. The guest who stays is safe but misses out. Coming together gives the best result.
missionCopy.choicePrompt: Will you sit at the table?

outcomes.COOPERATIVE: The feast is shared. Everyone eats well.
outcomes.BETRAYAL: One person is alone in the dark. The other is safe.
outcomes.MIXED: The table is empty. The food goes cold.
